metadata.score_definition: SimEnv benchmark_score: lower is better; final_score averages fresh final-verification shots when available; last_shot_score is the unaveraged final shot.
metadata.step_definition: One SimEnv.step per shot; repeats, replay and restoration included; reset shots counted separately. Episode totals include shared threading discovery plus both optimizer branches.
metadata.screen_change_definition: A change in selected physical screen between consecutive acquired shots within a reset segment; identical screen requests and initial selection at reset do not count.
metadata.wall_time_definition: Seconds. Per-shot, workflow-stage and worker episode durations use perf_counter. Worker elapsed time is captured before constructing the export. Batch elapsed time is recovered from UTC start/end timestamps and includes exporter repair; the metrics file additionally reports combined-JSON serialization time. Parallel worker times must not be summed to infer batch elapsed time.
metadata.data_definition: All acquired shot observations, actions, readbacks, scores and durations; screen images are not exported. Existing simulation outputs do not retain images.

export_recovery.reason: NumPy metadata serialization corrected after numerical tracking; reconstructed from complete workflow summaries and raw shot logs. No seeds or simulation measurements replaced.
export_recovery.batch_clock: UTC elapsed timestamps; per-episode and per-stage durations remain perf_counter timings
